lines.zh: 长槊拖在身后，我走得很稳。
lines.en: My spear trails behind me and my pace is steady.

lines.zh: 靴子踩过木门，门就碎了。
lines.en: My boot goes through a wooden door and it breaks.
I patrol along the shoreline.
Water drips from my clothes.

lines.zh: 我的槊比门框还长，让开。
lines.en: My spear is longer than your door; step aside.

lines.zh: 猎人的脚步，不该被听见。
lines.en: A hunter's steps should not be heard.

lines.zh: 我把槊扛在肩上，越过矮墙。
lines.en: Spear on my shoulder, I step over a low wall.
There is seaborn in the wind.
I skirt that pile of fishing nets.
My breathing is lighter than the wind.
I hug the wall with the point forward.

lines.zh: 这里的地面太干，我不习惯。
lines.en: This ground is too dry for me.
I walk past a row of empty houses.
I pause one step to listen for water.
On this shore I am the hunter.

lines.zh: 我把槊头压低，继续往前。
lines.en: I lower the spearhead and keep moving.
I stand with the spear upright beside me.
I am listening. It is surer than looking.
Water keeps dripping from my hair.

lines.zh: 我把槊刃在袖子上擦了擦。
lines.en: I wipe the blade on my sleeve.
This shore is too quiet.

lines.zh: 我盯着海面，那里有波纹。
lines.en: I watch the sea. There are ripples there.
My eyes see through murky water.
I am waiting for them to come ashore.
I touch the knife at my hip.

lines.zh: 我拨开湿发，听远处的水。
lines.en: I push wet hair aside and listen to the distant water.
Spear tip down, blood drips into the sand.

lines.zh: 这具身体的伤口好得很快。
lines.en: This body closes its wounds quickly.
I look up. The clouds sit low.
I plant the spear in sand and hold.
You are not my quarry.
Step back. Hunters dislike closeness.

lines.zh: 海水在你身上留下了味。
lines.en: The sea left its scent on you.

lines.zh: 你手里的武器，握得太紧了。
lines.en: You grip your weapon too tightly.

lines.zh: 我要是想杀你，你已经倒了。
lines.en: If I meant to kill you, you would be down.
What are you doing here?
Do not touch my spear.
Your hand has been behind you too long.
We are not the same kind of thing.

lines.zh: 你若看见别的东西，告诉我。
lines.en: If you see the other things, tell me.
The wound closes quickly.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，槊还在手里。
lines.en: Half a step back, spear still in hand.
This much pain I am used to.

lines.zh: 血滴在槊杆上，滑得握不稳。
lines.en: Blood on my spear shaft makes it slippery.
I press the wound and keep my eyes forward.

lines.zh: 身体在告诉我，它正在变。
lines.en: My body is telling me it is changing.
I bite down and make no sound.

lines.zh: 深海的槊，先推开你的门。
lines.en: The deep-sea lance opens your door first.
I straighten and grip the spear.

lines.zh: 伤口被海水一浸，更清醒。
lines.en: Seawater in the wound sharpens me.
Food? I eat simply.
I know that briny smell.
Leave it. I will come for it.
This smells much like the seaborn.
One taste. Acceptable.
I am not picky. Enough is enough.

lines.zh: 这个我不吃，你自己留着。
lines.en: I will not eat this. Keep it.
I divide the food into two.

lines.zh: 你站远一点，我吃东西的时候不放松。
lines.en: Stand back. I do not relax while eating.
When I finish I go back to the shore.
Do not bump me. The spear has no eyes.
That was light. I cannot be bothered.
Back away. I am soaked.

lines.zh: 深海猎人的长槊，先出手。
lines.en: A deep-sea hunter's lance strikes first.

lines.zh: 我侧身让半步，你可以过。
lines.en: I give half a step. You may pass.
At this distance I can reach you.
Do not walk right against me.
That noise will draw them.
Get your footing. You were near the point.
You are shorter. Keep your eyes low.

lines.zh: 深海猎人之间，不常有这种事。
lines.en: Such things are rare among Abyssal Hunters.

lines.zh: 我们身上都有海的味道。
lines.en: We all carry the sea on us.

lines.zh: 我和同伴背靠背睡过很多夜。
lines.en: My comrades and I slept back to back many nights.
Some of them did not come back.

lines.zh: 我把她的名字刻在槊杆上。
lines.en: I carved her name into the shaft.
Together we hold this sea.
We speak no gentle words.

lines.zh: 有一天我也会变成它们。
lines.en: One day I will become one of them too.
When that day comes, do it yourself.
I have said this only once.
This rope will lash the spear.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚被冲上岸的贝壳。
lines.en: I pick up a shell washed ashore.
This iron will hone the edge.
The net is torn. Still useful.
I pick up a broken bone.
An orb glimmers in the sand.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进外衣里面。
lines.en: I tuck it inside my coat.

lines.zh: 深海猎人的槊，只挑该挑的。
lines.en: A deep-sea hunter's lance picks only its due.
This blade is too light for my hand.
I press the shard back into the sand.

lines.zh: 水面上有东西浮起来了。
lines.en: Something has surfaced.
That smell is closer.
I take the spear down off my shoulder.
It comes around from behind the rocks.
One thrust reaches at this range.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸已经停了半拍。
lines.en: My breathing has stopped half a beat.
My long spear breaks the doorframe first.
I go in from its rear quarter.
There is no one else on this shore.
I extend my long spear to measure the distance.
It keeps drifting toward the village.

lines.zh: 它的甲壳在岸上刮出响声。
lines.en: Its shell scrapes audibly on the shore.
Ashore it is slow.
I wait for it to leave the water.
My point stays on it.
It stopped to sniff.
It turns and I hold still.
Two steps more and it is in reach.
It has no retreat left.
I am counting its rhythm.
The point drives in from the side.
I thrust and withdraw before the blood falls.
The shaft sweeps its legs.
I force it down into the sand.
My knife draws across its neck.

lines.zh: 我抬槊一挑，把它掀到沙上。
lines.en: I lift my spear and flip it onto the sand.
I hammer its head with the butt.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了它的动作。
lines.en: That broke its rhythm.

lines.zh: 我踩着它的身体拔出槊。
lines.en: I plant a foot on it and pull the spear free.
It is still up. Once more.
I walk up out of the water.

lines.zh: 湿衣服贴着身体，我不在意。
lines.en: Wet clothes cling to me. I do not mind.
I will watch this shore.

lines.zh: 槊在手里，我从潮线往内陆走。
lines.en: Spear in hand, I walk inland from the tideline.
The sea wind carries the salt in.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头发，水珠四散。
lines.en: I shake my hair and droplets scatter.
The village is still here. Good.
I reach the village gate and do not knock.
They will come ashore eventually.
I raise my head and look down this road.

lines.zh: 火焰烤着我的手臂，我没退。
lines.en: Fire sears my arm and I do not step back.

lines.zh: 落地时沙子陷了半个脚掌。
lines.en: On landing, my foot sinks half a palm into the sand.

lines.zh: 水把我按下去，我还想上来。
lines.en: Water holds me under and I still want up.
The blast throws me onto the rocks.
The arrow went into my shoulder seam.
This force is pulling at my blood.
Too long unfed and the spear wavers.

lines.zh: 雷落在槊杆上，一路传到我。
lines.en: Lightning hit the shaft and ran into me.

lines.zh: 我被拖进无边的黑水里。
lines.en: I am dragged into endless black water.
